description: Election Commission - C. M. Rambanda was Selected as the member of the Narammala Pradeshiya Sabha - M. N. M. Agad wes Selected as the member of the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha - A. Sandiravadani was Selected as the member of the Kotagala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to resignations or party membership changes, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies by Returning Officers, which falls directly under electoral processes and related matters.
